schedule: fixed 2000-step cosine horizon; 120-step checkpoint is not the M4 120-step schedule

stop_rule.hard_collapse: token std < 0.01 and token effective rank < 2, or nonfinite loss/features
stop_rule.sustained_degradation: at a checkpoint >= 500: pooled effective rank and pooled variance both <= 0.5 of preceding checkpoint and <= 0.5 of initial; stop longer unregularized extension
stop_rule.selection: formal budget fixed to 2000 unless this stop rule triggers; otherwise stopped checkpoint, never downstream-selected

diagnostics: all 384 training scans/24 plants, deterministic sample pairs, centred and uncentred, covariance entropy effective rank
inputs: M4 train XYZ cache only; no labels, validation or test

p4_candidate.risk_rule: at selected checkpoint token std or pooled std <= 0.5 of initial, and pooled rank <= 0.9 of initial; or early stop
p4_candidate.one_loss_only: student context-token variance/covariance regularization, SmoothL1 JEPA unchanged
p4_candidate.selection: no weight search; one preregistered setting only
